notes.title: Eye of the Storm Update
notes.content:
This update is packed with changes and fixes to EVERYTHING. 

[h2]Speech Recognition & Scoring[/h2]
We have built a brand new offline speech recognizer that is higher quality and more responsive for better scoring and no more dropouts.

[h2]Difficulties[/h2]
There are now 8 difficulties across our two modes that can take you smoothly from full lyrics generation to a challenge for even seasoned freestylers. 

[h2]Dynamic Rhyme Recognition[/h2]
Go off, make it your own, and TempestAI will reward you for adding your own rhymes. On higher difficulties of Freeflow you'll be challenged to come up with your own rhymes for our starter words.

[h2]Modifiers[/h2]
Play it your way: faster, slower, double time, no fail, no score.

[h2]Better Lyrics[/h2]
Freeflow's Tempest Topics have been completely overhauled to be more coherent, consistent, and fun to rap.

[h2]Organize Your Beats[/h2]
We've reworked the interface to let you sort the beats by artist, title, genre, length, speed, and your high scores.

[h2]And Much More[/h2]
There's so many fixes and changes it's impossible to cover everything here. Check it out for yourself!

notes.title: Infinite Storm Update
notes.content:
This is a huge content and gameplay update! We've added 3 new beats, the ability to load your own beats, searching topics, and a lot more!

[h2]Beats[/h2]
We've got a pack of 3 new Low-Fi beats from woolsee and evvnflo, but if you're not into Low-Fi we've still got you covered with INFINITE BEATS. You can now load all your MP3 and OGG files into Rhyme Storm and never run out of new jams!

[h2]Topics[/h2]
Topics are now searchable, if you want to try every topic about pirates you can! You can also revisit topics, just scroll up on the topics screen to see everything you've rapped about. 

[h2]Hypeman[/h2]
We've toned down Hypeman, you now get subtler cues when you're failing. You can also mute him entirely from the setttings menu!

[h2]Tempest AI[/h2]
We've made some updates and tweaks to the AI models and lyrics generation that has it working even better! Stay tuned for further updates soon, we're getting close to some big improvements in the Tempest Topics lyrics system.

[h2]Settings[/h2]
Yes, the settings menu now works! It also includes a link to our troubleshooting guide in case you're having problems with the speech recognition.

[h2]General Improvements[/h2]
We've made a bunch of small improvements all over the game including improvements to our scoring system, the ability to bail out of a rap by hitting ESC at any time, updating to the latest Unity engine, and too many tiny things to list.

We're really excited for you to try out the new improved Rhyme Storm, and there's plenty more updates to come!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
PORTLAND, October 5, 2020-- Flip Rhythm is thrilled to announce Rhyme Storm, the first freestyle rapping rhythm game, will be released on Steam Early Access on Monday, October 12.

Utilizing speech recognition, a unique scoring system, and AI lyrics generation, Rhyme Storm is a wholly new experience that challenges you to stay on your toes and on the beat as you deftly string together hard-hitting punchlines. Battle your way up the scoreboards as you progress through 6 levels of difficulty across two play modes. It's packed with awesome beats, hilarious topics, and mind blowing visuals that dance and pulse along to your performance. You won’t be asking if you can freestyle rap or not -- you’ll be wondering “how fast can I go?”

“After two and a half years of development we are thrilled to finally be launching Rhyme Storm,” said Tip McMahon, co-founder and CEO of Flip Rhythm. “We've really knocked down the barriers to freestyle rap, it still amazes me how quickly a player with no experience can start freestyling and get into a flow. And it's just so fun, there's nothing else like it.”

Game Features:
• A New Experience: The world's first freestyle rapping rhythm game
• Test Your Might: Get graded in real time and then see how you stack up on the scoreboards
• Killer Soundtrack: 20 awesome beats in various styles and speeds
• Find Your Groove: It's easy to get on beat with our slick visual guides, flashing words, and visualizers all pulsing to the music
• Hypnotizing Graphics:  unique visualizers throb and twist with the music, reacting to your performance and pulling you into the flow
• Get Pumped: Your own personal hype man backs you up, pushes you on, and cheers for every victory
• Freestyling: Off the Dome mode gives you rhymes built around your chosen topic, the rest is up to you!
• AI for MCs: Freeflow mode gives you full lyrics to rap in styles ranging from modern rap to Shakespeare, all powered by Tempest AI
• Laugh Your Butt Off: Over ten thousand hilarious topics with custom rhymes

It’s time to get your bars up and weather a Category 4 Rhyme Storm! Purchase Rhyme Storm on Steam for 15% off from October 12th to the 18th.
